The same happened on 10-06 and 10-07. The runner has landed a build on every 09:40 fire since 2026-10-06 regardless of the last verdict, which is why the served directory advanced while every verdict was REFRESH_FAILED, and why the entry the verdict protects is already absent from the served directory at inflection (since 10-06) and at cottonwood (since 10-07).
